common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.

landing.title: Bruno, a toy that learns with your child
landing.lead: Your child holds the paw, asks anything, and Bruno answers out loud. You decide what it may talk about, and for how long.
landing.point1: Short answers, one to three sentences, never a screen full of text.
landing.point2: Sensitive topics never reach the model: Bruno uses reviewed, fixed answers.
landing.point3: You see conversation summaries and alerts.
landing.privacyLink: What we store, and for how long
landing.demoNotice: This is a demo. Do not use a real child's details.

privacy.title: Privacy, briefly
privacy.stored1: Your email address and password (the password only as a cryptographic hash).
privacy.stored2: Your child's nickname, age, language, interests and chosen picture.
privacy.notStored1: Audio is never stored. A recording exists in memory only while speech is being recognised.
privacy.notStored2: No tracking, no ads, no third-party scripts.
privacy.retentionText: Conversation text is deleted after 30 days. You can delete summaries whenever you like. A deleted account is gone from the database within 24 hours.
privacy.whoText: You. By default you see summaries and topics rather than full transcripts; you can turn transcripts on yourself.
privacy.demoText: Until the child rights impact assessment is finished, please use test profiles only, with no real child's details.

register.title: Create a parent account
register.consentLabel: I have read what is stored and I agree.
register.sentText: If that address is not already in use, we have sent a confirmation link. It is valid for 24 hours.
register.devHint: In development, mail is caught locally; open Mailpit to read it.
register.needBoth: Both boxes need to be ticked.

verify.successText: One step left: set your PIN.
verify.failedTitle: This link is no longer valid
verify.failedText: Links are valid for 24 hours. Send yourself a new one.

login.title: Sign in
login.accountLocked: Too many attempts. The account is locked for 15 minutes.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: We will send a link to set a new password. It is valid for 1 hour.
forgot.sentText: If the account exists, the link has been sent.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.doneText: Every session on other devices has been signed out.
reset.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
reset.invalidText: Links are valid for 1 hour and can be used once.

pin.title: Set your parent PIN
pin.lead: You need this PIN to leave child mode. Four digits.
pin.mismatch: The two PINs do not match.
pin.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in 5 minutes.

dashboard.title: Your children
dashboard.noChildrenText: Create a child profile so you can hand the phone over.
dashboard.summariesSoon: Session summaries will appear after the first conversation.
dashboard.needVerify: Confirm your email address to continue.
dashboard.noDeviceSession: Please sign in again on this device.

wizard.nicknameHint: Not a full name. Up to 20 characters.
wizard.step2Title: What do they like, and which picture?
wizard.avatarHint: Your child signs in by tapping their picture.
wizard.sampleUnavailable: The voice sample arrives when we switch the voice on.
wizard.defaultsText: All activities on, 20 minutes a day, 07:00 to 20:30, memory on, transcripts off, email alerts on. You can change these later.
wizard.avatarTaken: Another child in the family already has that picture.
wizard.childLimit: A family can have at most 5 profiles.

child.exitLocked: Too many attempts. Try again in 5 minutes.
child.voiceSoon: The voice is switched on in the next step.

copy.greet: Hi, {name}! Want to talk, hear a story or play a game?
copy.holdPaw: Hold my paw while you talk, I'm listening!
copy.notHeard: I didn't quite hear you, can you say it again?
copy.fallback: Hmm, I'm a bit sleepy. Try again!
copy.goodbye: That was fun! Tell mom or dad what we learned. Good night!
copy.parentsCanSee: Mom and dad can see what we talk about.

admin.title: Admin
admin.emptyText: Model registry, evaluation runs, metrics and ratings arrive in M6.
